    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_36" sourceRef="Task_AdvanceCatheter" targetRef="Task_RemoveGuidewire"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" name="Not in good position" sourceRef="Gateway_WirePosition" targetRef="Task_AnesthetizeAndPuncture">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">wirePositionGood = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_38" sourceRef="Task_RemoveGuidewire" targetRef="Task_VerifyFlowAndReflow"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_39" sourceRef="Task_VerifyFlowAndReflow" targetRef="Task_CheckCatheterPosition"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_40" sourceRef="Task_CheckCatheterPosition" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
